description: Paired IPC optimization experiments; candidate/baseline ratios below 1 favor candidate. Same-code A/A controls are included. The native-copy candidate and compiled whole-class candidate were not retained; Python mmap-copy elimination is also not retained.
calibration: calibrated files use 9 samples, 30 alternating blocks per arm, 200 records per block, bounded capacity 64; each block includes consumer acknowledgement, and exact payload/FIFO validation. Earlier interleaved and independent-process trials are retained as additional evidence.

3.15-unpinned-aa.json.method: spawned single producer/single consumer; attachment excluded using readiness events; delivery timing includes consumer byte/FIFO validation and result collection; producer retries try_push on full and consumer polls try_pop; each alternating paired run constructs and unlinks a fresh ring
